user.title: Calendar zone
user.description: A zone that moves to the location of the current or next event on a calendar.

data.name: Zone name
data.delay_minutes: Delay before moving to the next event
data.title_filter: Only use events whose title contains

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant. You can change it later.
data_description.zone_id: Optional. Leave blank to base it on the name, for example 'Shift work' becomes zone.shift_work. Automations refer to the zone by this, so it can't be changed later.
data_description.calendar_entity: Events need a location (an address or coordinates). Events without one are ignored.
data_description.passive: A passive zone can trigger automations but does not change people's location state.
data_description.delay_minutes: After an event ends, keep the zone there for this long. If the next event starts sooner, the zone moves halfway through the gap.
data_description.title_filter: Optional. For example 'work' to ignore other events on the same calendar.
data_description.country_code: Optional. Limits address lookups to this country.
data_description.google_api_key: Optional. Uses the Google Geocoding API. Without a key, OpenStreetMap is used.

error.zone_exists: A zone with this entity ID already exists.
error.invalid_api_key: Google rejected the API key. Check that the Geocoding API is enabled for it.
error.invalid_zone_id: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, for example shift_work.

abort.already_configured: A calendar zone with this entity ID is already set up.
